784131a2839c62caf31b827110dd70d925d7cfdd.summary: Carbon Black's Threat Analysis Unit (published 2019-02-25) describes defeating compiler-level obfuscations, opaque predicates and control flow flattening, in APT10's ANEL RAT. The unit modified the public IDA Pro plugin HexRaysDeob. The modified tool deobfuscated 34 of 38 functions (89%) in one ANEL 5.4.1 sample.

techniques.q: Opaque predicate is a programming term that refers to decision making where there is actually only one path.
Control flow flattening is an obfuscation method where programs do not cleanly flow from beginning to end.

figures.q: The code is able to deobfuscate 34 of 38 functions (89%).
all ANEL samples whose version is 5.3.0 or later are obfuscated with opaque predicates and control flow flattening.

78ccec1251c3e760af649e5f64e4bd6e0f3301be.summary: Trend Micro blog (September 2022) on attackers exploiting the older Oracle WebLogic flaw CVE-2020-14882 to deploy Kinsing cryptocurrency-mining malware. It describes the infection chain: a crafted HTTP request leads to a downloaded shell script that disables security features and cloud agents, removes rival miners, and fetches Kinsing. It shows how Trend Micro Cloud One Workload Security and Vision One detected and blocked the activity, and gives threat-hunting guidance and MITRE ATT&CK mappings.
